name: better-neighbors-mcp
description: Better Neighbors for Claude Code: sets up our MCP servers

plugins.name: better-neighbors
plugins.description: Sets up Better Neighbors' four MCP servers (core, Youniverse, Clipix and Moonshot) in the app it runs in, Claude Code or ChatGPT, the same way in both: each server added with the app's own command, a Google sign-in for each, then a new chat. The plugin carries no servers itself.
